resources.string: Open DSH Desktop on your computer, scan the “Pair phone” QR code, and enter DSH right inside this app without browser restrictions.
Open DSH below, or scan a new QR code to replace this pairing.
1. Open DSH Desktop on your computer
2. Open the bottom-left account menu → “Pair phone”
3. Scan the QR code with this app
The pairing code is sent only to the server you scanned, and a new device must be approved on the computer. This app contains no analytics or ads.
Tap “Allow” in the DSH dialog on your computer. The code is valid for 5 minutes.

Only for the emergency case where the host is an IP address but its certificate is issued to a domain. Enabling this skips certificate verification for that host and exposes you to man-in-the-middle attacks.
This device will not be able to verify %1$s. An attacker could steal your DSH credentials. Continue only if this is your own server and a valid certificate is not available.
This clears the device credentials and WebView data stored on this phone. It does not remove the record from the computer; remove it later in DSH device management.
This app collects no analytics and uploads no device data. Pairing credentials stay on this phone and are encrypted with Android Keystore.

Allow MobiDSH to install unknown apps, then return and try again.

MobiDSH (移鲸) is the Android client for dsh2phone. It scans the QR code in-app, pairs natively, then opens DSH in a controlled WebView. It reuses the pairing QR code and relay device allowlist, and does not change the server-side security model.

It is not a replacement for DSH Desktop and does not keep a background connection.
